page-base-light.displayName: Page Base (light, mixed 14% with live horizon)

line-light.displayName: Hairline (light, mixed 12% with live sky top)

page-base-dark.displayName: Page Base (dark, mixed 26% with live sky top)

surface-dark.displayName: Surface (dark, mixed 18% with live sky top)

surface-2-dark.displayName: Surface 2 (dark, mixed 26% with live sky top)

display.purpose: Current temperature on the horizon; narrow and light.

value.purpose: Measured values in definition lists, tabular.

label.purpose: dt labels, notes; 0.75rem for dates and hints.

shadows.name: panel-light
shadows.purpose: Panels, search field, masthead buttons, map controls (light).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for sky, panels, popovers and bodies.

motion.name: sky-transition
motion.purpose: Registered @property transition of --sky-top, --sky-horizon, --sky-ground when the shown hour changes.

motion.name: body-move
motion.purpose: Sun or moon and knob moving along the arc.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Background and color changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion sets sky transition to 0 and removes all transitions and animations.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; Night Ink in light theme, Sun Gold in dark theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary-bg, #0f1b2d); color: var(--primary-ink, #ffffff); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary-bg, #0f1b2d) 86%, #ffc94d); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5bc4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dde2ea); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2, #f5f7fa); color: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--surface-2, #f5f7fa) 80%, var(--ink, #0f1b2d) 6%); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5bc4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: City Chip
components.description: Recent or favorite city; currentColor-based so it works on sky and surface.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/><path d="M12 7v5l4 2"/></svg>Rome</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 26%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 10%, transparent); color: inherit; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 20%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field in the auth dialog and settings.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dde2ea); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5bc4); outline-offset: 0; border-color: transparent; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--tone-warning, #b42318); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Theme, units, language, chart series and radar layer switches.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dde2ea); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2, #f5f7fa); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg__opt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #455166); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-seg__opt:hover { color: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); } .ds-seg__opt.is-active { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); font-weight: 650; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); } .ds-seg__opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5bc4); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Solid sky-tinted surface for every dashboard module.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 20px 22px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dde2ea); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.05), 0 10px 28px -16px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.22)); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel__title { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-panel__reading { font-size: 2.75rem; font-weight: 300; font-stretch: 76%; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panel__stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px 18px; margin: 16px 0 0; } .ds-panel__stats dt { color: var(--ink-3, #59657a); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-panel__stats dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sky Hero
components.description: Signature: computed sky above, ground band below the horizon at 74%, temperature resting on the horizon.
components.html:
New York
22°C
Feels like 21°
components.css: .ds-sky { position: relative; height: 360px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--sky-ink, #ffffff); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--sky-top, #2569cc) 0%, var(--sky-horizon, #8cc0f0) 74%, var(--sky-ground, #1c2a3a) 74%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--sky-ground, #1c2a3a) 88%, #070c24) 100%); } .ds-sky__city { position: absolute; top: 24px; left: 24px; color: var(--sky-ink-top, #ffffff); font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 650; font-stretch: 90%; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-sky__temp { position: absolute; left: 24px; bottom: 26%; font-size: 5rem; font-weight: 260; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.8; } .ds-sky__temp span { font-size: 0.3em; font-weight: 450; font-stretch: 100%; vertical-align: top; } .ds-sky__sun { position: absolute; left: 62%; top: 30%; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 36%, #fff7da 0%, #ffc94d 48%, #f2a516 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px rgb(255 205 90 / 0.16), 0 4px 56px 22px rgb(255 190 70 / 0.34); transition: left 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), top 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sky__sun:hover { top: 26%; } .ds-sky__land { position: absolute; top: 74%; left: 24px; padding-top: 14px; color: #f5f7fa; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-sky__label { display: block; color: #c9d0db; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Hour Scrubber Cell
components.description: Signature: hour cells on the ground band; selected hour gets a Sun Gold underline, the current hour a Sun Gold time.
components.css: .ds-scrub { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 44px); padding: 12px; background: var(--sky-ground, #1c2a3a); color: #f5f7fa; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-scrub__hour { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: ew-resize; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-scrub__hour:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); } .ds-scrub__hour:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffc94d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-scrub__time { color: #c9d0db; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-scrub__hour.is-now .ds-scrub__time { color: #ffc94d; font-weight: 700; } .ds-scrub__temp { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-scrub__hour.is-selected { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--sky-horizon, #8cc0f0) 10%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, #f5f7fa 18%, transparent); } .ds-scrub__hour.is-selected::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; right: 22%; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: #ffc94d; }

narrative.overview:
The page is the sky above the searched city at the hour on screen. Its colors are not chosen per theme; they are computed per hour from the sun's real altitude, the weather condition and the cloud cover, then written as custom properties on <html> and animated through registered @property colors. A full-bleed sky band carries the city, the local time, the sun or moon on its real arc, and the temperature resting on the horizon. Below the horizon a deep ground band of the same sky holds the secondary readings and the 24-hour scrubber; dragging the scrubber recolors the whole page.

Everything beneath the sky is solid: dilute tints of the live sky on page, surfaces and hairline rules, no translucent tiles and no decorative blur. Density is high and deliberate (week, hourly chart, air, UV, sun and moon, details, radar, tips), organized into flat panels with one shared type family whose width axis does the expressive work: condensed light numerals for readings, regular widths for interface text. Sun-gold is the one warm voice and it means "here": selection, the current hour, the scrubber handle, the city marker.

The world rejects the weather-app category's fixed dark-glass gradient with translucent cards. Theme is auto (follows the city's real sky: dark when the sun is below about -6 degrees), light or dark, exposed as html[data-theme]; html[data-sky-top-ink] records whether the upper sky needs light or dark text.
keyCharacteristics: Sky colors are computed data, never fixed palette picks; contrast is guaranteed by the algorithm, not by luck.
One family, Archivo variable (wdth 62-125, wght 100-900), self-hosted; width and weight carry the hierarchy.
Solid surfaces tinted by the live sky; hairline rules; soft two-layer shadows only.
Sun-gold marks selection and "now"; it is rare everywhere else.
Lucide line icons in a single stroke (1.75).
Motion follows the sky: 700ms sky transitions, 1.2s for the live tint, one expo-out easing; all of it collapses under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Computed Sky Rule
rules.body: Sky colors come from computeSky() (sun altitude, dawn or dusk, condition, cloud cover). Never hardcode a sky color on a surface; read the custom properties.

rules.name: The Guaranteed Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on the sky picks white or dark ink by worst-case contrast across sampled probes, and the sky itself is nudged darker or lighter in 6% steps until text reaches 4.6:1. The upper sky (city, masthead) and the horizon zone (temperature) are solved separately.

rules.name: The Ground Band Rule
rules.body: Below the horizon (74% of the band) the sky becomes ground: a deep tint of the same sky (horizon mixed 35% toward top), darkened toward Ground Floor only until secondary land text reaches 5:1. This is a cited adaptation for legibility, not a second palette; do not lighten it for looks.

rules.name: The Same Sky Below Rule
rules.body: Every surface under the hero is a solid, dilute tint of the live sky. No glass, no translucency over content, no decorative blur.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Sun-gold means selection, "now" or "here". Do not spend it on decoration or headings.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by width and weight of the one family. Numbers that are read at a glance go narrow and light; values that are compared go tabular. Do not introduce a second display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Times, temperatures, hours and measurements use tabular-nums so columns and the scrubber never jitter.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels are solid surface with a 1px sky-tinted line and the Panel shadow. Floating shadow is reserved for things that sit above the page (menus, toasts, dialog).

dos: Do read sky colors from --sky-* and --live-* and let computeSky() decide them; extend its stops or weather tints rather than painting a surface by hand.
Do keep text on the sky at 4.6:1 or better and secondary land text at 5:1 on the ground band, solved by the algorithm.
Do build every new surface as a solid fixed base mixed in oklab with the live sky, with a 1px sky-tinted line.
Do use Sun Gold only for selection, "now", the scrubber handle and location markers.
Do set readings in narrow light Archivo and comparable values in tabular figures.
Do draw icons with Lucide at strokeWidth 1.75.
Do animate with the one expo-out easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and honor reduced motion by removing transitions.
Do keep controls at 44px minimum and the 2px offset focus outline.
donts: Don't reintroduce the fixed dark-glass gradient with translucent tiles or decorative blur.
Don't apply CSS filters to map tiles or let Leaflet's default plus-lighter tile blending through.
Don't lighten the ground band below its 5:1 floor for aesthetic reasons.
Don't spend Sun Gold on headings, decoration or large fills.
Don't use data-series hues (temperature, rain, wind) as brand or status colors.
Don't add hard offset shadows; elevation is soft and ambient.
